creator: Earthbound
changes: Original Earthbound model from custom anatomical vertex surfaces: individually constructed carapace scutes, fitted relief limb scales, generated UV albedo/normal/roughness textures, a 12-bone skeletal rig, and original keyframed animation. No external model or texture was used. Morphological references: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service and Naturalis; their photographs were studied as reference only.
animationNote: Original in-place Idle, Walk, Turn, and Dig clips. Walk uses a slow stance phase and lifted recovery; Dig alternates forelimb scraping. These are interpretive motions for an educational exhibit, not motion-captured locomotion.
